preconditions.description: The length of word p is less than the length of word t, and both lengths are at least 1.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ai <= len(t) for ai in a)
preconditions.description: All elements in the permutation a are within the bounds of the length of word t.
The permutation a contains each index exactly once.

preconditions.expression: p can be obtained by removing letters from t
preconditions.description: The word p is a valid result of removing letters from word t according to the specified permutation a.

postconditions.description: The output is a single integer number.
The maximum number of letters Nastya can remove is non-negative.
The maximum number of letters Nastya can remove is less than or equal to the length of word p.

postconditions.expression: exists(substring in t for substring in all_substrings(t) if substring == p)
postconditions.description: The word p is a substring of t.
